name: Mitigation of Orbital Debris in the New Space Age
effect: Adopts new rules requiring satellite operators in low-Earth orbit to dispose of their satellites within 5 years of completing their missions
alignment_notes: Aligns with Pillar 1: serves as a key regulatory foundation for maintaining LEO orbital carrying capacity
sponsors: Jessica Rosenworcel (FCC Chairwoman), Geoffrey Starks (FCC Commissioner), Nathan Simington (FCC Commissioner)
